propositions: A failed identity write in create_one deletes the freshly created Jira issue, making it unrecoverable even though the issue was successfully created in Jira
The keyed-pending binding is never unbound on rollback, causing subsequent recovery passes to repeatedly attempt writes against a deleted key and strand the local ticket permanently
The rollback delete is redundant because record_pending_key runs before identity writes and recover_pending.keyed branch already implements deterministic retro-attach without search
A self-hosted DC instance with customized Create/Edit screens can trigger permanent identity-write failures via misleading Jira field screen validation errors
The operator must declare labels as a required field on the project's Create and Edit screens; createmeta pre-flight discovery is out of scope
